purpose: Live coding as a crowd thing. I want to see how people show code being written in front of others.

pages.title: Algorave

pages.title: TidalCycles
pages.reaction: TidalCycles is a live coding language that is basically Haskell wearing a rhythm costume, and I love that it was born for polyrhythmic percussion. The cyclic idea of time, borrowed from Indian classical music, is the bit that makes me want to patch something right now. Good ground for the crowd-coding question, and a pointer to where the algorave scene …
